overview.short: Statue of Unity in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat is home to the world's tallest monument (182m), Sardar Sarovar Dam, and the scenic Narmada valley.
overview.description: Standing at a monumental height of 182 metres against the scenic backdrop of the Vindhya and Satpura mountain ranges, the Statue of Unity in Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Gujarat, is the world's tallest statue. Dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the visionary leader who unified India, the complex features a high-tech museum, an observation deck at 153 metres, the engineering marvel of Sardar Sarovar Dam, and lush landscapes like the Valley of Flowers and Shoolpaneshwar Wildlife Sanctuary.
overview.about: Statue of Unity in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, is a world-class tourism hub featuring the iconic 182-metre colossus of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Set along the banks of the sacred Narmada River, visitors explore high-speed elevators to the 153-metre chest-level viewing gallery, the colossal Sardar Sarovar Dam, thematic floral valleys, jungle safaris, and evening laser light and sound spectacles.

topPlaces.entryFee: Included in Ekta Nagar Circuit Ticket
topPlaces.description: One of the world's largest concrete gravity dams harnessing the Narmada River, featuring dedicated viewpoints showcasing roaring water gates and vast reservoir expanses.

topPlaces.name: Zarwani Waterfall & Shoolpaneshwar Sanctuary
topPlaces.description: A secluded natural waterfall tucked inside the dense teak forests and rocky ravines of the Shoolpaneshwar Wildlife Sanctuary, ideal for eco-treks and birdwatching.

topPlaces.name: Narmada Riverfront & Valley of Flowers
topPlaces.description: A sprawling 24-acre floral park and river promenade on the banks of the Narmada River, featuring manicured flowerbeds, selfie viewpoints, and serene sunset walking trails.

itinerary.title: Day 1 — The Colossus & Sardar Sarovar Dam

items.note: Ascend high-speed elevators to the 153m Viewing Gallery and explore the Sardar Patel Memorial Hall.
Witness the massive spillway gates, powerhouse overview, and panoramic Narmada reservoir vistas.
Experience the spectacular high-powered laser projection show illuminating the 182-metre monument.
Take an early nature trail into the lush forests and rock pools of Shoolpaneshwar Wildlife Sanctuary.
Stroll through themed botanical gardens, Bharat Van, and scenic riverside viewpoints.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Statue of Unity?
faq.a: The best time to visit Statue of Unity is from October to March when temperatures range between 14°C and 28°C with pleasant weather for outdoor sightseeing and dam viewpoints.

faq.q: How do I reach Statue of Unity?
faq.a: The nearest railway station is Ekta Nagar (EKNR) just 5 km away with direct trains from Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Surat, and Delhi. The nearest airport is Vadodara Airport (BDQ), located 85 km away via a smooth 4-lane expressway.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Statue of Unity?
faq.a: 2 days are recommended to comfortably explore the Statue of Unity, 153m Viewing Gallery, Museum, Sardar Sarovar Dam, evening Laser Show, and Zarwani Waterfall.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost near Statue of Unity?
faq.a: Stays in Ekta Nagar start from ₹1,500 for budget lodges, ₹4,500–₹7,000 for upscale hotels, and up to ₹15,000 for luxury waterfront tent city resorts.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Statue of Unity?
faq.a: The top attractions are Statue of Unity & Museum, Sardar Sarovar Dam & Viewpoints, Zarwani Waterfall in Shoolpaneshwar Sanctuary, and Narmada Riverfront & Valley of Flowers.
